developmentEvidence: The new @ts-expect-error regression initially failed because the legacy unversioned profile type structurally admitted V4 options. Adding formatVersion?: never closes that TypeScript contract without admitting new runtime inputs.

List selection-bridge disposal uses its own captured intrinsic because its facade has distinct private ownership from the base bridge.
